INSIGHT: Tested retrieval against real Claude conversation messages across 4 projects. With MIN_SIGNALS=3, only 3/54 messages surfaced any memories.

SIGNAL HIT RATES (from real data):
- trigger: 7.69% — only signal that fires consistently
- tags: ~0% with old threshold, minimal with new
- domain: ~0%
- feature: ~0%
- content: 0% at threshold=4, ~1% at threshold=3
- vector: 0.69% at 0.30, ~2% at 0.25

WHY: Voice-transcribed messages are short, fragmented, conversational — "right, it got squished, the pill is big as shit" doesn't match structured metadata like domain:overlay, tags:[overlay,pill]

FIX: Dropped MIN_SIGNALS back to 2. The other tightening (decay, intent, importance floor, content overlap, tag threshold) still meaningfully filter noise without needing 3 independent signals.

RESULT after fix: 0.73 avg/message, 0 false leaks vs 0.06 avg before
